phases.name: Build Config
phases.notes: Smooth conversion: WAR→JAR, Java 8→17, Quarkus BOM added, dependencies replaced, maven-war-plugin removed. Handled system-scoped audit library gracefully.

phases.name: App Config
phases.notes: Created comprehensive application.properties with datasource, Hibernate, Flyway, and AMQP messaging config. Deleted 4 XML descriptors cleanly.

phases.name: EJB to CDI
phases.notes: Largest phase (15 steps). Converted all service beans, REST endpoints, entities, and producer methods. Removed @Remote interface and JNDI lookups. All javax→jakarta namespace updates successful.

phases.name: Messaging
phases.notes: Complex transformations: 2 MDBs (one with WebLogic JNDI setup) to @Incoming, JMS producer to Emitter. No errors despite complexity.

phases.name: Lifecycle
phases.notes: Converted EJB @Startup and WebLogic ApplicationLifecycleListener to Quarkus @Observes events. Clean transformation.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.notes: Deleted 3 WebLogic stub classes, removed ShippingServiceRemote interface. Left codebase clean with no legacy artifacts.

Removed JNDI lookups and replaced with CDI injection
Converted EJB lifecycle to Quarkus lifecycle events
Created application.properties with datasource and messaging config
